knowledge.title: Kidney history requires longitudinal context
knowledge.text: Chronic kidney disease assessment concerns abnormalities persisting for at least three months. One low eGFR during an acute illness cannot establish chronicity; retrieve longitudinal measurements and the clinician assessment.
